name: West Farm S.C.
summary: West Farm S.C. is a 210,305 square foot community shopping center located in Farmington's West Farms trade area, neighboring Westfarms Mall and Corbin's Corner. The property features a quality tenant roster and serves an affluent Hartford suburban market with strong household incomes and a population base exceeding 620,000 residents within 10 miles.
demographics: West Farm S.C. serves an affluent Hartford suburban market with median household incomes of $85,257 within 3 miles and $82,731 within 10 miles. The trade area encompasses over 620,000 residents within a 10-mile radius, with average household incomes exceeding $114,000, indicating strong purchasing power. The center attracts primarily middle to upper-middle class families and professionals from the West Farms area of Farmington and surrounding Hartford suburbs, with daytime populations reaching nearly 730,000 within 10 miles, suggesting significant workforce and commuter traffic.
description: West Farm S.C. is a well-established community shopping center strategically located in the West Farms trade area of the Hartford, Connecticut MSA at 1600 South East Road in Farmington. Spanning 210,305 square feet of gross leasable area with ample parking at a ratio of 5.07 spaces per 1,000 square feet, the center serves as a convenient retail destination for the affluent Hartford suburbs. The property boasts a quality tenant roster and benefits from its prime location neighboring both Corbin's Corner and the prominent Westfarms Mall, creating a synergistic retail corridor that attracts shoppers from across the region. The center serves a prosperous trade area with median household incomes exceeding $82,000 within 10 miles and a population base of over 620,000 residents, providing retailers with access to customers with strong purchasing power. Managed by Kimco Realty Corporation, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers, West Farm S.C. offers tenants professional property management, comprehensive leasing support, and the benefits of being part of a best-in-class retail portfolio.
